fields.description: Public host clients hit, e.g. api.grove.example.com; used to build the base_url returned by provision_endpoint. With a Fleet Zone set it must be exactly one label under it, because that is all a wildcard certificate covers, and it resolves to every proxy through GeoDNS.
fields.label: Gateway Host

fields.description: Public DNS zone the proxies live in, e.g. grove.example.com. Every proxy is reachable at its own name inside the zone (proxy-name dot zone) and serves one wildcard certificate for the whole zone, which is what lets them all answer for the same Gateway Host behind GeoDNS. Blank = no TLS: boxes keep serving /v1 and /grove-admin in the clear on port 80.
fields.label: Fleet Zone

fields.description: How long a client that names no session of its own stays pinned to one engine. 0 balances every such request across the engines serving a model, which is the point of running two. A duration (30m, 2m) trades that for a warm prefix cache per API key — 30m is what every gateway did before this field existed. A client that sends X-Grove-Session or a `user` field is always pinned and is not affected either way. Reaches a box on Deploy Agent.
fields.label: Synthetic Session TTL

fields.description: Whose credentials own the zone above: they answer the DNS-01 challenge and write each proxy's records. AWS only — the zone must be a public Route53 hosted zone in that account.
fields.label: DNS Provider

fields.description: Where Let's Encrypt sends expiry warnings. Blank registers without one, so a stalled renewal goes unannounced.
fields.label: ACME Email

fields.description: Issue from Let's Encrypt's staging CA — untrusted by clients, but not rate-limited. Leave on until the issuance works end to end: production allows five certificates a week for one name.
fields.label: Use ACME Staging

fields.description: Read off the certificate below. Renewal is a daily job that only acts inside certbot's 30-day window, so this date moving is how you know it is alive.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: The full chain every proxy serves. Written by Issue Fleet Certificate; pushed to each Active proxy on provision and on renewal.
fields.label: Certificate

fields.description: Its private key, encrypted here and on no box in this database. One key for the whole fleet: a compromised proxy can impersonate every name under the zone, so treat a box breach as a reason to reissue.
fields.label: Private Key

fields.description: When certbot last ran, whether or not it changed anything.
fields.label: Last certbot Run

fields.description: What that run printed, successful or not. A renewal that was not yet due says so here and changes nothing else — which is the normal nightly result.
fields.label: Last certbot Output

fields.description: Where a Monitoring Agent pushes when its Region names no endpoint of its own, e.g. http://13.206.253.38:8000/v1/write. Prefer https — the agent's token crosses the network on every push. The token itself lives on each agent.
fields.label: Metrics Remote Write URL

fields.description: 16+ characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~ — e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Every Monitoring Agent sends it to fetch its target list, and it is the only thing guarding that list; unset, the endpoint refuses everyone. It travels in the query string, so it appears in this site's access log — rotate it here and hit Install on each agent.
fields.label: Service Discovery Token

fields.description: Guards /metrics/node and /metrics/gpu on every box — e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Boxes get its hash, the agent gets the password. Unset, a box writes no htpasswd at all and nginx refuses the endpoint. Rotating it means re-running each box's play (Setup, Update Engine Config, deploy_openresty.yml) and Install on each agent.
fields.label: Metrics Scrape Password

fields.description: Derived from the password above and written to each box's htpasswd file. Recomputed only when the password changes, so re-running a play does not rewrite the file. Hidden: it is a verifier the boxes check against, with nothing an operator sets or reads.
fields.label: Metrics Scrape Password Hash

fields.description: JSON stamped on every series pushed from every box, e.g. {"env": "prod", "tenant": "grove"}.
fields.label: Extra Labels
